phase_partition.rationale: Quartz/Chalcedony 在 <100C 动力学抑制且天然水恒过饱和, Vaterite 是 CaCO3 亚稳相; 若计入限值集会给出无意义的 CoC_safe=0 (已实测确认)。该选择本身即'相选择敏感性',已记录。

original_implementation.note: 原实现只对同时具备 Ca/Na/Cl/SO4/alkalinity/silica/pH 的样本跑 PHREEQC → 实际只有 IEUA 得到非 NaN 的 CoC_phreeqc = 2.5202

header_lines: #  under development by Peter de Moel (Omnisys) for Stimela platform at Delft University of Technology
#  based on: phreeqc.dat (file date 2015-01-27, as part of Phreeqc Interactive 3.1.7-9213)
#  Stimela is focussed on modelling for water and waste water treatment
#  - added [Fe+2], [Mn+2] and [N+3] (with master species [Fe+2]+2 , [Mn+2]+2 and [N+3]O2-) for redox-uncoupled Fe+2, Mn+2 and NO2-
#  - added [N-3] (with master species [N-3]H4+) as alternative for redox-uncoupled Amm (with master species AmmH+)
#  - added [C-4] and [S-2] (with master species [C-4]H4 and H2[S-2]) as alternatives for redox-uncoupled Mtg and Sg)
#  - uncommented defintions for Amm (for using Tony Appelo's input files)
#  - added solid Vaterite (CaCO3) (included in Standard Methods 2330 (2010))
#  - modified values for element_gfw according to Standard Atom Weights from TSAW 2013 (CIAAW/IUPAC)
# PHREEQC.DAT for calculating pressure dependence of reactions, with
#   molal volumina of aqueous species and of minerals, and
#   critical temperatures and pressures of gases used in Peng-Robinson's EOS.
# Details are given at the end of this file.

#   molal volumina of aqueous species and of minerals, and
#   critical temperatures and pressures of gases used in Peng-Robinson's EOS.
# Details are given at the end of this file.
